description: Tests: stop_loss unit=ticks, take_profit unit=ticks, risk_unit stop_unit=ticks
source:
# =============================================================================
# EXEC CLUSTER E07: Tick-Based Stops
# Tests: stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.ticks), take_profit(unit=StopUnit.ticks)
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

fast = ma(period=20, type=MAType.ema)(close)
slow = ma(period=50, type=MAType.ema)(close)
is_bull = fast > slow
held = hold_until()(enter=is_bull, exit=not is_bull)

long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held)
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=20)
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.ticks)(distance=10)
take_profit(unit=StopUnit.ticks)(distance=20)
